name: an informational ticket comment starts no run
description: After CoderHelm's PR was closed, the ticket owner wrote that the fix was made in the booking system. The comment used to re-run the ticket and open the same PR again. It records the lesson, marks the ticket done, and starts nothing.
comment: This was fixed in the booking system: the winter term is now available on the web, and the class shows on the site after the sync.
